team.name: Troy High School Mock Trial
team.description: Troy Mock Trial is focused on building a strong generation of advocates, public speakers, and critical thinkers while fostering a community of advancement. We introduce students to the field of law, offering real-life trial experience and fostering effective communication skills. Members develop public speaking, critical thinking, legal practices, and advocacy — competing in the Constitutional Rights Foundation's Mock Trial program since 2016.

coreValues.legalStudies: Troy Mock Trial helps students acquire a working knowledge of the judicial system through hypothetical cases, research of actual case law, and preparation of original legal arguments.
coreValues.competition: Troy Mock Trial competes in the CRF-OC (Constitutional Rights Foundation – Orange County) and the JSerra Catholic High School Mock Trial Tournament annually.
coreValues.skills: Members develop public speaking, critical thinking, legal reasoning, and professional advocacy skills that carry into college and careers in law and beyond.

coaches.name: Coach Harold
coaches.bio: Plays an intensive role in the development of every student advocate on the team. Provides rigorous, individualized feedback on all competition materials — from direct examination to closing arguments — while maintaining constant involvement in practice sessions. Works closely alongside Coach Davis to prepare members at the highest competitive level, ensuring the team is sharp, confident, and ready to perform when it matters most.
